archiveTitle: Daily Brief | Steam achievement sets and GTA6 trailer

entries.headline: Quarantine Zone details its free Miami Zero expansion
entries.summary: Xbox Wire details Quarantine Zone’s free Miami Zero expansion, set in Miami at the start of the outbreak. Additions include inspection mechanics, a research center, quests, dynamic weather and over 30 unique survivors. No platform-wide launch timing is inferred.

entries.headline: Grand Theft Auto VI: GTA6 launch trailer shows new Jason and Lucia footage
entries.summary: IGN reports that Rockstar has released GTA6’s launch trailer, showing new footage of Jason, Lucia and the open world. The trailer identifies the footage as captured on PS5. The report describes cinematic scenes rather than a gameplay demonstration.

entries.headline: JDM: Ph4ntom Driver announced for PC
entries.summary: AUTOMATON reports that Gaming Factory has announced JDM: Ph4ntom Driver for PC via Steam, with no release date set. The Japanese Drift Master spin-off combines arcade-style open-world driving with supernatural enemies and vehicle customization.

entries.headline: RuneScape Reignited canceled after player feedback
entries.summary: IGN reports that creative director Mod Ryan announced the cancellation of RuneScape Reignited in an official video and blog post, citing player feedback. The fresh-start mode was intended for new and returning players; the cancellation does not concern RuneScape itself.

entries.headline: Steam beta introduces grouped achievement sets
entries.summary: AUTOMATON reports that Valve has introduced achievement sets in the Steam client beta. Supported games can group achievements by category, such as solo and co-op content. The beta feature addresses issues including the effect of DLC achievements on completion records.

entries.headline: Psychological horror game Encryption announced for PC in 2027
entries.summary: Gematsu reports that Digital Lighthouse Games has announced Encryption for PC via Steam in 2027. Set amid a climate catastrophe in southern Italy, the first-person psychological horror adventure combines exploration, puzzles and stealth as a father searches for his missing daughter.
